svg.title: A test allowance is more than media spend
svg.desc: Hypothetical planning exercise, AUD excluding GST. Total included allowance 2,400 equals 800 included setup, management, page and measurement work plus 1,600 media. If spent at the assumed average CPC of 8, media gives 200 arithmetic clicks, not people, enquiries or a prediction of customers. Independently assumed first-time customers, one first job each: 2, 4 or 6. At 500 contribution per first job after stated variable delivery costs and before marketing and other excluded costs, balances after the included allowance are minus 1,400, minus 400 or plus 600. Five first jobs cover only the included marketing cost if assumptions stay unchanged. This is not a quote, forecast, observed campaign, net profit, cash flow or causal ROI.

g.text: Setup, management, page and measurement work are included.
Only if spent at that average. Clicks do not predict customers.
First-time customers, one first job each · not forecasts
Contribution follows stated variable delivery costs;
marketing and other excluded costs still need accounting for.
5 first jobs cover only the included marketing cost.
Assumptions must stay unchanged. Not net profit, cash flow
or causal ROI. No campaign or result is represented.
